_: The daily stories' pictures (STORY1, spec 22 Oct 2026, sections 1.2-1.5), drawn by gen-adventure.mjs. Each story: a cast lineup first (Echo for scale beside that day's new characters), then s01-s08 and e01-e04 as tall pages, then Home's card. `light` is the story's light line (a scene's own `light` wins); `bible` names every character as NAME: so a page can be told who is NOT in it; `buddy` is the empty spot left for the child's own buddy, laid over the picture later (never painted in). `also` attaches an earlier picture of the same place (story/part), so Echo's cottage and the helper map look the same on every day.
echo: ECHO: the hero, a small round clay bird shaped like a ball, sky blue, with a pale-blue belly patch, two small teal wings, a short orange beak, two orange feet, big round glossy eyes and pink cheeks, and two head feathers on top (one coral pink, one yellow), exactly like the attached Echo picture. Echo is small: as tall as a grown-up walrus's knee.

light.day: warm, rich, sunny colors (bright blue sky, fresh greens, clear water) with gentle even daylight (no harsh golden glare, no sparkles)
light.night: a soft, cozy blue-violet evening lit warmly by lamps; never dark or scary: a deep blue-violet sea and sky, soft lilac cotton-candy fog, one round cream moon, and warm butter-yellow lamplight as the brightest thing, every face clearly and warmly lit (no harsh glare, no sparkles)
light.afternoon: a warm, soft late afternoon: a pale peach-and-butter sky, long gentle shadows, every color warm and clear (no harsh glare, no sparkles)
light.sunset: a soft peach-and-lilac sunset, warm and gentle, every face clearly lit (no harsh glare, no sparkles)
light.indoor: a warm honey-colored morning light pouring in through a big round window, cozy and bright (no harsh glare, no sparkles)
light.evening: a cozy lamp-lit evening indoors, warm and soft, every face clearly lit (no harsh glare, no sparkles)
light.dusk: a soft woodland dusk: the sky fading from lilac to deep blue, gentle cool moonlight on every face so each one is clearly and warmly readable; NO lamp, lantern, window or candle is lit anywhere (the only glow in the whole picture is the little glowworm's tail), no harsh glare, no sparkles

places.cottage: ECHO'S COTTAGE: a small round clay cottage with cream walls, a round sky-blue front door, round windows with soft yellow frames, a domed straw-colored thatched roof, a little wooden porch with two wide steps, and a low white picket fence along a garden path with flowers.
places.map: THE HELPER MAP: a big hand-drawn paper map of a little island pinned to the wall, in soft crayon colors: a red-and-white lighthouse on a rocky point, a little toy shop in a town, a stone bridge over a river to a round island of pink blossom trees, and the other places hidden under soft white puffy clouds. No writing, no labels, no numbers anywhere on it.

stories.bible: PELLY: Pelly the pelican, a big white clay pelican (a real pelican, not a duck) with a very long, straight peach-orange bill, longer than her head, and a big, soft, lumpy peach pouch hanging under it, a small round light-blue postal cap with a little white envelope badge (no anchor), no scarf, and a brown leather mail satchel across her body; about twice Echo's height. WALLY: Captain Wally the walrus, a big, round, chubby grey-brown clay walrus (a sea animal with flippers, not a bird, no beak), with a wide whiskery grey muzzle, two long white tusks pointing down from his mouth, a bushy white mustache, small kind eyes behind round wire glasses, a tiny navy-blue captain's hat with a little gold anchor badge, a red-and-white stripy scarf, and a round, very red nose because he has a cold; he has flippers instead of hands and feet; he is the BIGGEST character: about three times Echo's height and taller than Pelly. MICE: three little grey clay mice with round pink ears, each about half Echo's height.

stories.bible: PELLY: Pelly the pelican, a big white clay pelican (a real pelican, not a duck) with a very long, straight peach-orange bill, longer than her head, and a big, soft, lumpy peach pouch hanging under it, a small round light-blue postal cap with a little white envelope badge (no anchor), no scarf, and a brown leather mail satchel across her body; about twice Echo's height. GARDENER MOUSE: Gardener Mouse, ONE honey-brown clay mouse (brown, not grey) standing upright on two legs, with big round peach-pink ears, a pink nose, rosy cheeks, a long thin pink tail, a wide floppy straw sun hat with one white daisy tucked in its band, green overalls (dungarees) with one big front pocket over a cream shirt, and little brown boots; a little taller than Echo. DUCKS: two friendly clay ducks, always the same two: a mallard with a glossy green head, a thin white neck ring and a soft grey-brown body, and a speckled light-brown duck; both with orange bills and orange webbed feet; each about as tall as Echo. FROG: one little round leaf-green clay pond frog (a real frog, not a toy: no wind-up key) with a few darker green spots on its back, big golden eyes, a pale cream tummy and a wide happy smile; about half Echo's height. The place in this story is Gardener Mouse's garden on a sunny green hillside: sandy paths, low wooden beds of herbs, little seedlings, berry bushes and flowers, a white picket fence, a little stone spring near the top of the garden with a small wooden gate in front of it, a big chunky wooden waterwheel near the spring, a little wooden water tank on legs beside the wheel, open wooden water troughs (long wooden channels shaped like little slides, each with a U-shaped groove down its middle) and a small round stone-edged pond lower down the hill. Until the ending pages, no water runs anywhere at all; the spring's little wooden gate is shut, the stone spring basin is still, the wheel is dry and still, every trough is empty and dry, the pond is an empty bowl of dry pebbles, and the flowers droop; never draw a waterfall, a stream, a trickle or a splash on a page before the ending.

chars.prompt: Glowworm, full body, sitting up on his back half, facing forward, smiling: a small, chubby, cheerful clay glowworm (a soft little bug shaped like a round caterpillar; not a snake, not a snail, no shell, no wings, no clothes) with a pale butter-yellow body made of four round segments, a big round head with big glossy eyes, small pink cheeks and a wide smile, two thin antennae with little round tips, six tiny legs, and a round tail end that glows a soft warm golden yellow like a little night-light; one tiny front leg raised in a wave.

stories.bible: PELLY: Pelly the pelican, a big white clay pelican (a real pelican, not a duck) with a very long, straight peach-orange bill, longer than her head, and a big, soft, lumpy peach pouch hanging under it, a small round light-blue postal cap with a little white envelope badge (no anchor), no scarf, and a brown leather mail satchel across her body; about twice Echo's height. HARE: Stationmaster Hare, a friendly clay hare who stands upright, with soft cream fur that is light golden-tan on her back, her cheeks and the tips of her very long upright ears (pink inside), a pink nose, small whiskers and big hind feet, a red knitted scarf and a little shiny brass whistle on a red cord around her neck; no hat; about one and a half times Echo's height, ears included. FROG: Frog, Hare's helper on the train crew (the same Frog who plays the drum in the pond band), a big, round, plump, bright leaf-green clay frog with a smooth cream belly, a few soft darker-green spots on his back legs, big round friendly brown eyes on top of his head, a wide happy smile and small pink cheeks; no clothes, no scarf, even in the snow; here he stands upright on his long back legs; about one and a half times Echo's height. SQUIRREL: Squirrel, a cheerful russet-orange clay squirrel with a cream tummy, tufted ears, a big curled bushy tail and a cream knitted scarf, always with her red wooden sled with two curled runners; a little taller than Echo. BADGER: Baker Badger on his day off, a friendly, round clay badger standing upright on two legs (a real badger, not a raccoon, no mask ring and no striped tail): a white face with one broad black stripe running back over each eye, a shiny black nose, small round white-tipped ears, a soft grey back, black arms and legs, a muted teal shirt with a collar and its sleeves rolled up, a warm brown woolly vest over it and a muted teal knitted scarf; today he wears no chef's cap and no apron, because it is his day off from his bakery; about twice Echo's height. THE DUCK FAMILY: a white clay mother duck with an orange bill and orange webbed feet, about one and a half times Echo's height, and her two fluffy little yellow ducklings with orange bills, each about half Echo's height; always exactly these three, never more ducklings. THE TRAIN: the brand-new valley train, a chunky little toy steam train of exactly two parts and no face: in front, a steam engine with a turquoise boiler wrapped in gold bands and a round gold front, a red cab with one window and a turquoise roof, a tall red chimney with a gold rim, a small gold dome, a red cowcatcher at its front and turquoise wheels with big gold hubs; behind it, one turquoise-and-cream passenger coach with a rounded cream roof, gold trim and rivets, two big open windows and turquoise wheels with big gold hubs; it is big enough for Hare to sit inside and look out of a window; no writing or numbers on it. Snowdrop Valley in this story is a soft, snowy valley of rounded snowbanks, small fir trees dusted with snow, little white snowdrop flowers and cream winter sunshine, with a cozy honey-wood station with a snowy roof and a little brass bell hanging by its door, a low rounded sledding hill, two honey-wood cottages with snowy roofs among the fir trees, and a small round pond of clear blue water (not frozen) with snowy banks. The track pieces are chunky toy-train track pieces, straight and curved, each made of honey-wood sleepers with two smooth grey rails on top. Until the ending pages, no railway track is laid anywhere: the snow of the valley is smooth and bare where the tracks will go, the train stands on the snow by the station, and no rails or sleepers show on any page before the ending.

stories.bible: PELLY: Pelly the pelican, a big white clay pelican (a real pelican, not a duck) with a very long, straight peach-orange bill, longer than her head, and a big, soft, lumpy peach pouch hanging under it, a small round light-blue postal cap with a little white envelope badge (no anchor), no scarf, and a brown leather mail satchel across her body; about twice Echo's height. SWALLOW: Mama Swallow, a slim, friendly clay barn swallow (a real swallow with a slim body and long pointed wings, not a round ball like Echo, not a duck), with a glossy deep navy-blue back, head and wings, a rusty-orange forehead and throat, a cream-white tummy, a small pointed black beak, kind round eyes, small pink cheeks, little dark feet and a long forked tail with two thin tail streamers; she wears a little sunflower-yellow neckerchief knotted at her neck; she is about one and a half times Echo's height. CHICKS: Mama Swallow's three chicks, three round, fluffy baby swallows, all three the same size, each about half Echo's height: soft smoky-grey down on top, cream tummies, little rusty-orange faces, wide yellow-edged beaks, small pink cheeks, short stubby wings and tiny stubby tails; never sky blue, so they never look like Echo. THE LIFT: the basket lift at the foot of the cliff, just left of the nests: a tall, sturdy honey-wood post, as tall as the cliff, with a long wooden balance beam across its top like a seesaw high in the sky; from the beam's left end hangs the stone basket, a round woven basket for stones; from its right end hangs the lift basket, a big round woven basket on a long rope that rides up and down right beside the nests' round doorways; a little wooden winch wheel with a handle on the post winds the rope; a short shiny golden rail runs from just under the beam's right end into the top nest's round doorway; and three smooth round grey-green stones with cream-white dots painted on them (one with one dot, one with two dots, one with three dots; dots only, never numbers) go in the stone basket. The place in this story is the nest village on Sandstone Cliff, a tall, warm peach-and-cream sandstone cliff with soft rounded rock layers, tufts of sage-green plants and little white flowers, under a bright blue sky with soft white clouds: up its face, one above another, five cozy round nest rooms are carved into the rock, each with a round doorway, a little shelf and a round bed of woven straw inside, the top nest the widest; a very narrow twisty stair, just wide enough for Echo to squeeze up, is carved into the rock and winds up past them; at the foot of the cliff lies a wide flat ledge of warm sand, with a far canyon view behind it.

Echo hurries along the path in the lower middle, wings out, happy and excited, little puffs of dust behind him. No one else is in the picture.

Echo stands on the right, wings on his cheeks, surprised.

Echo stands in the lower middle, waving at the fawn, delighted. Fizz the little fox stands on the left, both paws clasped, happy.

s07.picture: Fizz's party clearing at a soft lilac sunset, every paper lantern glowing a warm golden yellow all around it and the glowing fireflies twinkling in the air. stories.bible: PELLY: Pelly the pelican, a big white clay pelican (a real pelican, not a duck) with a very long, straight peach-orange bill, longer than her head, and a big, soft, lumpy peach pouch hanging under it, a small round light-blue postal cap with a little white envelope badge (no anchor), no scarf, and a brown leather mail satchel across her body; about twice Echo's height. SANDY: Sandy the sea turtle, a friendly clay sea turtle about one and a half times Echo's height who stands up on her two back flippers like a person: a soft sea-green body, four flat, rounded paddle flippers (no legs, no feet, no claws, no fingers), a round, gently domed honey-and-caramel shell with a soft pattern of big rounded patches, a pale butter-yellow tummy, a round friendly face with big round eyes, small pink cheeks and a wide happy smile, and a little floppy coral-pink sun hat with a wide soft brim; no glasses, no flowers, no scarf. SEAL: a little clay seal pup, soft silver-grey with a pale cream tummy, a round head with no ears showing, big shiny dark friendly eyes, a round black nose, long white whiskers, small pink cheeks, two front flippers and two little back flippers at the end of her body; when she sits up on her tummy with her head raised she is about Echo's height. SEAHORSE: a little clay seahorse about Echo's height, sunny butter-yellow with soft orange spots, a curly tail, a short round snout, a small frilly fin on its back, big friendly eyes and small pink cheeks; it floats upright in the water. The place in this story is Sandy's beach: a little curved beach of soft golden sand on a calm turquoise bay, with small gentle waves, a few smooth round grey rocks, tufts of green beach grass on low sandy dunes and one leaning palm tree. On the beach stands Sandy's sandcastle: a chubby, round, golden sandcastle about three times Echo's height, with one tall round middle tower and four short round towers around it, little round windows poked into its walls and a round arched door, on a small raised bump of sand above the waves.
stories.home: A wide picture for a game card. On a sunny golden beach beside a calm turquoise bay with small gentle waves, Sandy's chubby round golden sandcastle stands tall, its towers dotted with pretty pink and white shells, a leaning palm tree far behind it. Echo waves happily from the top of the tall middle tower, and Sandy the sea turtle stands just left of the sandcastle, waving one front flipper and smiling. Echo, Sandy and the sandcastle are all in the middle band of the picture: their tops below 25% from the top and their bottoms above 75% from the top, the sandcastle just right of the middle. Only Echo and Sandy appear: no other characters.

stories.bible: PELLY: Pelly the pelican, a big white clay pelican (a real pelican, not a duck) with a very long, straight peach-orange bill, longer than her head, and a big, soft, lumpy peach pouch hanging under it, a small round light-blue postal cap with a little white envelope badge (no anchor), no scarf, and a brown leather mail satchel across her body; about twice Echo's height. ZIPPY: Zippy the zebra, a young, round, friendly clay zebra about twice Echo's height (as tall as Pelly), who stands upright on his two back hooves and uses his front hooves like hands: bold, wavy black-and-white stripes all over, a short fluffy black-and-white mane standing up along his neck like a little brush, a soft round grey nose, small pink cheeks, big friendly eyes, little round ears, a short tufty tail, a small round red bandleader's cap with a fluffy yellow pompom on top, and a shiny red parade jacket with gold trim and one big gold zipper down the front; the jacket hangs open unless the scene says it is zipped up; never scary. ZOOKEEPER: the zookeeper, a big, gentle, round grey clay elephant about three times Echo's height, standing upright on two legs, with big floppy ears with pink insides, a long curly trunk, small pink cheeks, kind eyes, a little green zookeeper's cap with a round leaf badge (no writing) and a green vest with one pocket. MONKEY: a little brown clay monkey about Echo's height, with a cream face and tummy, big round ears, a long curly tail, small pink cheeks and big friendly eyes. HIPPO: a round, chubby lilac-grey clay baby hippo about one and a half times Echo's height, with a wide happy smile, tiny round ears, small pink cheeks and big friendly eyes. The place in this story is Zippy's zoo: a sunny, friendly clay zoo with no cages, no bars and no fences, just soft green lawns, round flower beds, leafy round trees and a little blue pond, a winding cream-colored parade path with strings of little black-and-white striped flags across it, and at the front a big round arched gate painted with black-and-white zebra stripes. On the path waits the parade float: a big, chubby, rounded clay wagon on four big round wheels, painted with black-and-white zebra stripes, with a soft round stage on top, a ring of round light bulbs all around its edge and one big round red button on its front, about four times Echo's height. The zookeeper's xylophone, wherever a scene shows it, is a big, bright clay xylophone on little wheels: a row of chunky rainbow-colored bars from long to short on a wooden frame, played with round-headed mallets. Zippy the zebra, his shiny red parade jacket zipped up and his little red cap on, stands at the front of the float's stage with one front hoof raised high, and Echo bounces beside him, waving excitedly. Echo, Zippy and the float are all in the middle band of the picture: their tops below 25% from the top and their bottoms above 75% from the top, the float just right of the middle. Only Echo and Zippy appear: no other characters.

stories.bible: PELLY: Pelly the pelican, a big white clay pelican (a real pelican, not a duck) with a very long, straight peach-orange bill, longer than her head, and a big, soft, lumpy peach pouch hanging under it, a small round light-blue postal cap with a little white envelope badge (no anchor), no scarf, and a brown leather mail satchel across her body; about twice Echo's height. REMI: Remi the reindeer, a friendly, round clay reindeer (a girl) about twice Echo's height, antlers included, who stands on her four legs: soft cocoa-brown fur, a cream tummy, a cream muzzle with a round dark-brown nose, a fluffy little cream tail, big friendly glossy eyes with long lashes, small pink cheeks, two small soft round ears, two small, soft, rounded honey-colored antlers, each with a few short rounded branches with round tips (never sharp), little dark-brown hooves, and a cozy knitted mint-green scarf around her neck; no hat. She wears her jingle bells only in a scene that says she wears them: a soft brown leather strap with a row of little round shiny silver jingle bells, across her chest. The place in this story is Remi's snowy hill: a round hill covered in soft, deep, smooth snow, with a few round snowy pine trees, and on its top a little round honey-wood barn with a curved snowy roof and a wide round door; a low wooden fence of round posts runs along a snowy road that winds up the hill to the barn. Remi's sleigh is a small, round, shiny bright-red sleigh with a curly front that swirls up like a curl, a soft cream seat cushion and two curved silver runners, about as long as Remi; it is the only bright red thing on the hill. Remi's reins are long, soft, brown leather reins with little brass buckles.

stories.bible: PELLY: Pelly the pelican, a big white clay pelican (a real pelican, not a duck) with a very long, straight peach-orange bill, longer than her head, and a big, soft, lumpy peach pouch hanging under it, a small round light-blue postal cap with a little white envelope badge (no anchor), no scarf, and a brown leather mail satchel across her body; about twice Echo's height. RINA: Rina the ray, a gentle, friendly clay ray (a girl) shaped like a soft, rounded manta ray, never a stingray: no barb, no spine, no stinger and no horns. Her body is one smooth, wide, rounded diamond shape with two big, soft, rounded wing-fins that ripple gently at their edges like a cape, about four times as wide as Echo from wingtip to wingtip and big enough to carry Echo and a friend on her back; a short, smooth, thin tail with a soft rounded tip; a soft lavender-purple back sprinkled with little round white spots and a pale cream-white tummy; and at her rounded front edge a friendly face with two big round glossy eyes, small pink cheeks and a wide gentle smile with no teeth showing; no hat, no bow, no clothes. She never stands up: she always glides or floats flat in the water like a real ray, flapping her wide wing-fins slowly like wings. TURTLE: a big, gentle, friendly clay sea turtle (a boy) about twice as long as Echo is tall and big enough for Echo to ride on his shell, who swims flat like a real sea turtle: a soft olive-green head and four flat, rounded paddle flippers (no legs, no feet, no claws, no fingers) with a few pale round freckles, a big, gently domed, warm caramel-brown shell with a soft pattern of big rounded golden patches, a pale cream tummy, and a round friendly face with big kind eyes, small pink cheeks and a wide happy smile; no hat, no glasses. REEF FISH: the reef fish, a happy crowd of small, round, friendly clay fish, each about a third of Echo's height, in sunny yellow, coral pink, sky-teal and lilac, some with soft white stripes and some with round white spots, each with big friendly glossy eyes, small pink cheeks and a little smile. SILVER FISH: a school of tiny, slim, shiny silver clay fish, each about a quarter of Echo's height, with big friendly eyes and little smiles, that swim close together in one long, wavy line. The place in this story is Rina's reef: deep under a calm sea, in soft, bright, clear turquoise water lit by gentle sunbeams slanting down from the rippling surface far above (never dark, never murky), a small round reef on a pale sandy sea floor, with smooth round rocks, round ball-shaped corals, branchy corals and soft swaying green sea grass. When the story begins, a thick, smooth blanket of plain gray sand covers the whole reef, so every rock and coral is plain gray with no color showing at all; once the sand is brushed away, the corals shine in bright colors: soft red coral with chubby little round-tipped branches that sway gently like tiny waving fingers (coral branches, never hands), round ball-shaped corals in sunny yellow, purple and pink, and at last every color of the rainbow. Echo swims and floats under the water just as he is (no helmet, no goggles, no snorkel), with a few tiny bubbles rising around him.

stories.bible: PELLY: Pelly the pelican, a big white clay pelican (a real pelican, not a duck) with a very long, straight peach-orange bill, longer than her head, and a big, soft, lumpy peach pouch hanging under it, a small round light-blue postal cap with a little white envelope badge (no anchor), no scarf, and a brown leather mail satchel across her body; about twice Echo's height. SAMI: Sami the seal, a young, round, friendly clay harbor seal (a girl) about one and a half times Echo's height when she sits up tall on her tummy with her head raised; she scoots and wiggles along the ground on her flippers and never stands like a person: soft dove-grey fur with a few darker charcoal-grey spots, a pale cream tummy, a round head with no ears showing, big shiny dark friendly eyes, a round black nose, long white whiskers, small pink cheeks, two front flippers and two back flippers together at the end of her body like a tail, and a coral-red sweatband around her head; no clothes, no hat. PUPPY: a silly little clay puppy (a girl) about Echo's height, standing on four short legs: soft, fluffy cream fur with one big caramel-brown patch around her right eye, two long floppy caramel-brown ears, a round black nose, big goofy friendly eyes, small pink cheeks, a little pink tongue poking out, a short curly tail, and a little sunny-yellow collar with no tag. TEAMMATES: Sami's three soccer teammates, each wearing a matching coral-red sweatband around its head: a little clay penguin (a boy) about Echo's height, with a round black-and-white body, a white tummy, a short orange beak, small orange feet, two little flipper wings, big friendly eyes and small pink cheeks; a little clay sea otter (a girl) about one and a quarter times Echo's height who stands up on her back legs, with soft chocolate-brown fur, a pale cream face with white whiskers, small round ears, a round black nose, big friendly eyes, small pink cheeks and a long thick tail; and a little round clay duckling about two thirds of Echo's height, with fluffy sunny-yellow feathers, a small orange bill, orange webbed feet, big friendly eyes and small pink cheeks. The place in this story is the soccer field by the beach: a bright green grassy soccer field with soft white chalk lines (a line around its edge and a circle in the middle) and one white soccer goal with a soft white net at its far end, at the edge of a sunny park with round leafy trees and a winding path; beside the field lies a strip of soft golden sand and a calm blue sea with small gentle waves. At the edge of the park, where the sand begins, stands a square wooden sandbox full of pale sand with a little red bucket in it, and beside it a big, round, leafy green bush. The soccer ball is a classic round soccer ball, white with black patches, with no writing and no logo. No sweatband, ball or goal has any number or letter on it.

stories.bible: PELLY: Pelly the pelican, a big white clay pelican (a real pelican, not a duck) with a very long, straight peach-orange bill, longer than her head, and a big, soft, lumpy peach pouch hanging under it, a small round light-blue postal cap with a little white envelope badge (no anchor), no scarf, and a brown leather mail satchel across her body; about twice Echo's height. CECIL: Cecil the centipede, a short, chubby, very friendly clay centipede (a boy), cute and never creepy: his body is a short row of round, soft, ball-like segments in a gentle curve, like a row of big round beads, soft lilac-purple with a pale lavender underside and a few round pink spots; his big round head is the front ball, held up high, with big round glossy friendly eyes, small pink cheeks, a wide happy smile and two short, soft, curly antennae with little round tips (no pincers, no fangs, no jaws, nothing sharp); the ball just behind his head stands up too and has two short little arms with round little hands; behind it, six more round balls rest on the floor, each on two short, stubby, rounded little legs with round little feet (twelve little feet in all); and a tiny cherry-red bow tie under his chin. s05.picture: In Sasha's little garden, the same round wooden garden bed, big soft white clouds still covering the sun. The soil in the bed is dug up now, soft, dark and crumbly, and the big striped sunflower seed rests in a little hollow in the middle. Echo stands on the right and tips the round red watering can very gently, so only a tiny trickle of water, just a few drops, falls onto the seed: a little sip. Sasha the squirrel kneels on the left, paws clasped, watching happily. Nothing is growing yet.

s06.picture: In Sasha's little garden on a bright day. In the blue sky in the upper middle, the big soft white clouds are floating away to both sides, and the big, round, warm yellow sun shines down on the garden, its warm light spilling over everything. Echo and Sasha the squirrel stand beside the round garden bed in the lower middle, faces turned up to the sun, eyes closed, smiling in the warmth. In the bed the dark soil is still damp, the big striped seed resting in its little hollow, and nothing has come up yet.

s07.picture: In Sasha's sunny little garden. Sasha the squirrel and Echo stand side by side at the round garden bed in the middle, singing a happy song to the seed with their mouths wide open, Sasha swaying with both paws held out toward it and Echo with his wings spread wide. A few small soft round clay music-note shapes float up above them (soft clay shapes, not letters). In the bed the big striped seed still rests in its little hollow in the dark soil, and nothing has come up yet.

s08.picture: In Sasha's sunny little garden, close up on the round garden bed. Pop! The big striped sunflower seed in its little hollow in the middle of the picture has just cracked open at the top, and a tiny bright-green shoot with two little round leaves peeks out of it. Sasha the squirrel kneels on the left and Echo kneels on the right, leaning in close, gasping with joy, paws and wings up.

e01.picture: In Sasha's little garden under a bright, sunny blue sky, the round friendly sun shining. The sunflower is growing tall now: one sturdy green stem with big, soft, heart-shaped leaves stands in the round garden bed in the middle, already as tall as Sasha, with a small closed green bud at its top, reaching up toward the sky. Sasha the squirrel on the left and Echo on the right stand beside it on tiptoe, stretching up as tall as they can, laughing.

e02.picture: In Sasha's sunny little garden. The sunflower's green stem rises just right of the middle, now very, very tall, up through the whole picture, with big heart-shaped leaves and a round closed green bud at its top, near the top of the picture. Just left of it stands a wobbly, giggling tower of exactly seven little squirrels, each standing on the shoulders of the one below: Sasha the squirrel at the very bottom, holding everyone up, and her six little squirrel friends above her. Even so, the stem is taller than the top squirrel. Echo stands at the foot of the stem in the lower middle, looking up, wings out, amazed.

e03.picture: In Sasha's little garden in the warm late afternoon. At the top of the very tall green stem, the huge round sunflower has just opened in the upper middle of the picture: bright sunny-yellow petals all around a big round chocolate-brown middle, glowing in the warm golden sunshine, as bright as sunshine itself. Below, Sasha the squirrel and Echo stand at the foot of the stem, looking up, cheering, paws and wings raised high, warm sunshine on their faces.

e04.picture: Evening inside Echo's cozy round cottage, lamp-lit: the whole helper map (THE HELPER MAP, the same map as in the attached earlier picture, seen whole as it is there, with its frame and its four brass pins in view) pinned to the wall, filling the upper middle of the picture, with no writing anywhere on it. Most of the map is still covered by soft white puffy clouds. One soft white cloud has just drifted off to one side, uncovering a new place: a tiny garden with a tiny woven fence and one tiny tall yellow sunflower with a round brown middle. There is NO star of any kind on the map or anywhere else in the picture, except the ONE new gold star Echo is pressing on. A low wooden bench stands under the map; Echo stands on the bench, on tiptoe, pressing ONE new shiny gold star sticker onto the tiny garden with one wing, beaming. A little cloth pouch full of big striped sunflower seeds rests on the bench beside him, a few seeds spilled out beside it. Plain wooden floor below.

stories.bible: PELLY: Pelly the pelican, a big white clay pelican (a real pelican, not a duck) with a very long, straight peach-orange bill, longer than her head, and a big, soft, lumpy peach pouch hanging under it, a small round light-blue postal cap with a little white envelope badge (no anchor), no scarf, and a brown leather mail satchel across her body; about twice Echo's height. SIMON: Simon the sloth, a slow, smiley and cuddly clay sloth about one and a half times Echo's height who stands up on his short back legs like a person: soft, shaggy, light caramel-brown fur, a round cream face with soft dark-brown patches around his eyes that curve down like a gentle smile, big friendly glossy eyes, a small round dark-brown nose, a wide, sleepy, happy smile, small pink cheeks, long cuddly arms whose hanging-claw hands are drawn as soft, rounded mitts (no sharp claws, no fingers), short legs with soft rounded mitt feet, and a little lime-green knitted beanie hat; no other clothes, no glasses, no scarf; he moves slowly and always looks calm and happy. SISTER: Simon's little sister, a tiny, cuddly clay sloth about three quarters of Echo's height, with the same soft, shaggy caramel-brown fur, round cream face with soft dark-brown eye patches, big friendly glossy eyes, small pink cheeks and soft rounded mitt hands (no sharp claws, no fingers), and a little white daisy tucked behind one ear; no hat, no clothes. FRIENDS: two little park friends who come to play, always these same two: a little grey clay bunny about Echo's height, with long soft ears with pink insides and a fluffy white tail, and a little round clay hedgehog about Echo's height with soft, smooth, rounded brown spines (soft-looking, never sharp), a cream face and a shiny black button nose; no clothes. The place in this story is the playground in the park: a sunny little playground on soft green grass, ringed by round leafy trees and a low trimmed hedge, with a smooth pale-grey sidewalk leading in. It has a curly yellow slide, a wooden frame with two swings, a big square wooden sandbox full of soft golden sand, and the seesaw: one long, smooth wooden plank painted mint green, resting on a round red stand in the middle, with a round wooden seat at each end, each seat with a little curved wooden handle in front of it and held on by two shiny silver bolts. Echo's toy saw, wherever a scene shows it, is a chunky clay toy saw with a round red handle and a short, soft, rounded wavy edge: a toy, never sharp.
stories.home: A wide picture for a game card. In a sunny little playground in a green park, the long mint-green seesaw on its round red stand tips happily, a curly yellow slide and round leafy trees behind. Simon the sloth sits on the high end on the left in his lime-green beanie, holding the handle with one soft mitt and waving with the other, smiling his slow happy smile, and Echo sits on the low end on the right, waving both wings and laughing. Echo, Simon and the seesaw are all in the middle band of the picture: their tops below 25% from the top and their bottoms above 75% from the top, the seesaw's red stand just right of the middle. Only Echo and Simon appear: no other characters.

chars.prompt: Simon the sloth, full body, standing up on his short back legs like a person, facing forward, giving a slow wave with one soft mitt and smiling: a slow, smiley and cuddly clay sloth with soft, shaggy, light caramel-brown fur, a round cream face with soft dark-brown patches around his eyes that curve down like a gentle smile, big friendly glossy eyes, a small round dark-brown nose, a wide, sleepy, happy smile, small pink cheeks, long cuddly arms whose hanging-claw hands are drawn as soft, rounded mitts (no sharp claws, no fingers), short legs with soft rounded mitt feet, and a little lime-green knitted beanie hat; no other clothes, no glasses, no scarf.

Simon's little sister, full body, standing, facing forward, waving one soft mitt and smiling: a tiny, cuddly clay sloth with soft, shaggy caramel-brown fur, a round cream face with soft dark-brown eye patches, big friendly glossy eyes, small pink cheeks and soft rounded mitt hands (no sharp claws, no fingers), and a little white daisy tucked behind one ear; no hat, no clothes.

s01.picture: A bright sunny morning at the round blue front door of Echo's cottage (ECHO'S COTTAGE, exactly as in the attached earlier picture), the round yellow morning sun shining high in the blue sky above the roof. Pelly the pelican stands on the left of the door and proudly pulls a big floppy straw sun hat with a wide, wobbly brim and a sunny-yellow ribbon out of her beak pouch, the hat dangling by its brim from the tip of her bill as if it were a letter, looking very pleased with herself. Echo stands just right of the middle on the wide doorstep, laughing, wings up.

s02.picture: Close up on the porch of Echo's cottage on a sunny morning. Pelly the pelican's big white wing (only her wing and the edge of her body, from the left edge) holds out a cream paper letter in the upper middle of the picture. On the letter is a child's crayon drawing of a smiling brown sloth in a little green hat beside a seesaw with a seat on only one end, its other seat lying on the ground under the bare end: only crayon lines, no writing at all. Echo stands just left of the middle, leaning in toward the letter, eyes wide with excitement, the floppy straw sun hat on the porch beside him.

s03.picture: A bright sunny morning in a little town park. A smooth, pale-grey sidewalk made of neat paving slabs runs up through the middle of the picture between soft green grass, round leafy trees and a low trimmed hedge, leading to the playground ahead in the upper middle: a curly yellow slide, two swings and the mint-green seesaw on its round red stand. Echo hurries along the sidewalk in the lower middle, wings out, happy and excited. No one else is in the picture.

s04.picture: At the playground in the park on a sunny morning. In the middle of the picture stands the mint-green seesaw on its round red stand, tipped down on its left end: the left end still has its round wooden seat with its little curved handle, but the right end is bare, with nothing on it but two empty bolt holes. Simon the sloth stands on the left beside the seat, both soft mitts on his cheeks, puzzled and silly, not sad. Echo stands on the right beside the bare end, wings up, surprised. The rest of the playground is empty and still.

s05.picture: In the big square wooden sandbox at the playground on a sunny morning, full of soft golden sand. The missing round wooden seat lies half buried in the sand in the middle of the picture, only its curved handle and one edge poking out. Echo digs beside it on the right, scooping sand away with both wings, little sprays of sand flying, beaming. Simon the sloth kneels on the left, slowly digging with one soft mitt, smiling his sleepy smile. The seesaw stands behind the sandbox, its right end still bare.

s06.picture: At the playground beside the mint-green seesaw on a sunny day. Echo walks in from the right, proudly carrying his chunky clay toy saw with its round red handle under one wing and a little open wooden box of shiny silver bolts in the other. In the middle, the dug-out round wooden seat, brushed clean of sand, leans against the seesaw's red stand, not on the seesaw yet. Simon the sloth stands on the left, giving a slow, happy wave with one soft mitt.

s07.picture: At the playground on a sunny day, close up on the right end of the mint-green seesaw. The round wooden seat with its little curved handle is back on the seesaw now, held on with two shiny silver bolts. Echo stands beside it on the right, giving the last bolt one more twist with a little toy wrench, beaming. Simon the sloth stands on the left and gently presses on the seat with one soft mitt to check that it is firm, nodding slowly and smiling: it is nice and safe. The little box of shiny bolts and the toy saw rest on the grass.

s08.picture: At the playground on a sunny day. The mint-green seesaw on its round red stand is whole again, level in the middle of the picture. Simon the sloth sits on the left seat, holding its handle with both soft mitts, and Echo sits on the right seat, holding its handle with both wings, both smiling at each other, ready to bounce.

e01.picture: At the playground on a sunny day. The mint-green seesaw tips mid-bounce in the middle of the picture: Simon the sloth's end is up high on the left, one soft mitt holding the handle and the other thrown up with joy, his slow smile wide with delight, and Echo's end is down low on the right, his feet just pushing off the grass, laughing. Both are having super fun.

e02.picture: At the playground in the warm late afternoon. Echo has just hopped off the right end of the mint-green seesaw and holds the seat steady with both wings while Simon's little sister, the white daisy behind her ear, climbs onto it, beaming. Simon the sloth sits on the left seat, smiling his slow happy smile and waving his sister on with one soft mitt: it is her turn.

e03.picture: At the playground at a soft peach sunset, everyone playing and giggling together. On the mint-green seesaw in the middle, Simon the sloth and his little sister bounce up and down, giggling with silly scrunched-up faces. Echo whooshes down the curly yellow slide on his tummy on the left, wings out, pulling a silly face. The two little park friends have joined in: the little grey bunny swings high on a swing on the right, and the little round hedgehog turns a silly somersault in the sandbox just in front of the seesaw, everyone laughing.

e04.picture: Evening inside Echo's cozy round cottage, lamp-lit: the whole helper map (THE HELPER MAP, the same map as in the attached earlier picture, seen whole as it is there, with its frame and its four brass pins in view) pinned to the wall, filling the upper middle of the picture, with no writing anywhere on it. Most of the map is still covered by soft white puffy clouds. One soft white cloud has just drifted off to one side, uncovering a new place: a tiny green park with a tiny curly yellow slide and a tiny mint-green seesaw. There is NO star of any kind on the map or anywhere else in the picture, except the ONE new gold star Echo is pressing on. A low wooden bench stands under the map; Echo stands on the bench, on tiptoe, pressing ONE new shiny gold star sticker onto the tiny seesaw with one wing, beaming. A shiny silver bolt rests on the bench beside him, next to his supper: a little round bowl of warm vegetable stew with a spoon in it, a soft curl of steam rising. Plain wooden floor below.

arcade: A wide picture for a button. Echo, cheerful and waving, in the very middle of the picture, with fun game things tumbling around him in the air: a juicy watermelon slice, an orange basketball, a black-and-white piano key, a soccer ball, and a cartoon dinosaur bone. A soft, bright sky-blue background with a few puffy clouds. Echo fills the middle third of the picture's width and the middle of its height; the game things stay around him. No text.
_chars: Each story's lineup is composed, not drawn: every character in `chars` is drawn alone on a transparent background, then gen-adventure.mjs stands them side by side on cream with ImageMagick, Echo first, each scaled to `h` (its height, Echo = 1). One character at a time keeps them from merging (the whole lineup in one picture gave Pelly the walrus's scarf, then lost her into him, 22 Oct 2026).
